repair_reason: CL2.1 found that CL2 primary learner success was not admissible because it was confounded by rule-family inductive bias. CL2.2 tests data-dependence under prior ablation.
dataset_scope: CL2 candidate safe action ledger only; one-step action admission plus safety-policy continuation
primary_question: Does transition prediction performance depend on safe-ledger training data rather than on an encoded transition prior?

required_splits.source_state_holdout: complete source states held out from training

learner_families.evidence_eligible_generic_learner: generic subset-table/backoff learner over visible features; does not encode the exact transition family
learner_families.zero_fit_variant: same learner class with no target training

metrics.data_gain: full_data structural_holdout exact accuracy minus zero_fit structural_holdout exact accuracy
metrics.tiny_to_full_gain: full_data structural_holdout exact accuracy minus 1_percent structural_holdout exact accuracy
metrics.corruption_drop: full_data structural_holdout exact accuracy minus best corrupted-target structural_holdout exact accuracy
metrics.source_holdout_full_accuracy: full-data exact accuracy on source-state holdout
metrics.structural_holdout_full_accuracy: full-data exact accuracy on structural holdout
metrics.cross_phase_full_accuracy: full-data exact accuracy on cross-phase holdout

downstream_halt_rule: No representation analysis, derivability claim, autonomous rollout, LLM scaling, or substrate claim unless decision is DATA-DEPENDENT-LEARNING-OK.
provenance_attestation: This preregistration file was written before CL2.2 dataset construction, training, diagnostics, and metric computation. Thresholds must not be changed after seeing results.
